name: Johnny
source:
Son of Dog Head.
His mother was a diva at the Amaryllis nightclub.
He has been frequenting her dressing room since he was a little boy and got to know Yvet.
He was bullied at school, but Yvet introduced him to Breeze, who taught him self-defense and freed him from the torment.
Under the influence of her mother, he aspires to become an entertainer.
He was imprisoned by Boss Ting and rescued by Yvet and her team.
He is gay and has a crush on Yau Tsi-chi, whom he met during the Umbrella Revolution.
